messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: model-serving v2.4.1 -> prod/us-west (10% traffic). Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2.4.1
sara: saw a quick 5xx bump on the SLO dashboard, p95 latency ok but error rate jumped ~1.2% in last 2m :thinking_face:
jon: can you paste the query you used?
sara: prom query: ```sum(rate(http_requests_total{env="prod",region="us-west",handler="generate",status=~"5.."}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{env="prod",region="us-west",handler="generate"}[2m])) * 100``` -> returned 1.2
ben: also seeing increased backend retries in the logs, kvcache pressure around the same time
charlie: suggestion: pause rollout, pin traffic back to v2.4.0 while we investigate. /deploy pause 2187654321
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by charlie. Current traffic remains at v2.4.0
slo-bot: Current metrics (prod/us-west, 5m window): p95=230ms, error_rate=1.25%, token_throughput=-3%
sara: can someone check autoscaler events and GPU OOMs? I see occasional OOM in node-3.
ben: tail logs: ```kubectl -n prod logs pod/model-srv-3 -c inference | grep -i oom``` -> few OOM lines at 14:02:11
jon: opening incident - linking to runbook and change window
charlie: let's do a canary rollback to v2.4.0 for affected hosts and run extended preflight tests. I'll handle rollback if OK
sara: ack, I'll run the longer 30m SLO smoke test after rollback
ben: adding note to release notes: "paused v2.4.1 rollout due to 5xx increase in us-west" :memo:
charlie: final: pause confirmed, incident#INC-2026-042 created, assigning oncall@redwood
